create_phimoe_config: create a PhiMoEConfig instance with custom hidden size and attention heads for a MoE model
load_phimoe_config_from_pretrained: load a PhiMoEConfig from the pretrained microsoft/Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct model on HuggingFace
configure_phimoe_experts: configure the number of local experts and experts per token in a PhiMoEConfig
validate_phimoe_rope_scaling: validate the rope scaling configuration with longrope type and factor lists in PhiMoEConfig
set_phimoe_router_params: set the router auxiliary loss coefficient and jitter noise parameters in a PhiMoEConfig
